# Frozen AEPX Edge Fixtures

These eight files are byte-identical copies of the frozen fixtures under
`imports/aviutlas-rust-contracts/aviutl-rs/tests/fixtures/`. They are test
inputs for read-only parsing and in-memory round-trip validation. Their
inclusion is not AEPX generation or editing: no fixture content, encoding, or
line ending is changed, and no project file is written by the tests.
